headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: CM Vijay pays tribute to composer Deva, TN govt announces state honours.
Revanth Reddy has sought action plan to tackle El Nino impact.
Advocates protest in Shivamogga demanding HC circuit bench.
Toll in Djibouti boat sinking rises to 139 dead, with 30 more bodies found.
Counter Congress’ campaign against SIR, Telangana BJP chief tells party cadre.
bullets_ur: CM Vijay ne composer Deva ko khiraj pesh kiya, TN govt ne sarkari aezazaat ka elaan kiya.
Revanth Reddy ne El Nino ke asraat se nimatnay ke liye action plan talab kar liya.
Shivamogga mein wukala ka HC circuit bench ke mutalbay ke liye ehtijaj.
Djibouti mein kashti doobnay se halakaton ki tadaad 139 hui, mazeed 30 laashein baramad.
SIR ke khilaf Congress ki mohim ka jawab dein, Telangana BJP chief ki karkunon ko hidayat.
